title: T1 tick-archive integrity: ~21 of 27 DWX symbols in the 2026-09-13 governed T1 M1 export share the SAME ~25-day gap 2025-10-09 .. 2025-11-03 (found by 9e0fb916 F5 re-run; not AUDCAD-specific). Root-cause read-only: (1) is the gap in T1's Bases/Custom tick archive itself (.tkc per symbol-month 202510/202511: content-verify against the signed custom-history manifest of Variant A, copy-on-claim receipts, containment/archive-loss journals of Oct-Nov 2025 = DL-085 class?) or only in the CopyTicksRange path (terminal tick DB not serving that window)? (2) do T2..T10 show the same hole (compare the .tkc sizes/hashes for 202510 across terminals against the archive manifest)? (3) which backtest windows are affected: any Q10_NEWS / Q11 full-history / OOS-2026 / DL-089 census run whose window covers 2025-10-09..2025-11-03 on an affected terminal - list the work items (read-only DB query) and classify the evidence impact (verdict-relevant or not); (4) propose the repair path (re-import of the affected months from the signed archive via the governed custom-history tooling) as a proposal, do not execute
why_now: If the T1 archive lost ~25 days of ticks for 21 symbols, every full-history or recent-window backtest on T1 over that window ran on a hole without saying so; the Variant A isolation is content-verified against a signed manifest, so this is either a manifest-vs-disk drift (containment/archive-eater class, DL-085) or a tick-DB serving defect. Not book-sprint critical (live EAs never read the archive), but evidence integrity for Q10/Q11/OOS rows is at stake. Source: docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-15_dukascopy_export_fix_r2/README.md (F5 section, 'Major finding').
